text: Month one. Three hundred thousand steps. You step on the weighing scale... (beat) A few hundred grams. That's it. Your friend laughs. Walking doesn't work, bro. {neutral} But something is working. You've started walking after dinner. Researchers in Ireland pooled seven studies. Even a few minutes of light walking after eating softens the blood sugar spike that sitting brings. Your body is changing. Just not where you're looking.
